home.work.note: Each one is picked the same way: small enough that we can finish it, and finished before we announce it.

home.how.intro: None of this came out of a strategy document. Each product began as something one of us wanted for an evening's own work — and we stay its heaviest user long after release.
home.how.p1_t: It starts as something we needed ourselves
home.how.p1_b: Both of these began as a tool one of us wanted on an ordinary evening and could not find. Nothing here was scoped in a meeting, which is why each one is narrow enough to actually finish.
home.how.p2_t: We use them every day, so we notice first
home.how.p2_b: We are the heaviest users of everything we ship, every day, on our own machines. The annoyance you would have written to us about has usually already annoyed one of us first.
home.how.p3_t: We build on work that already holds up
home.how.p3_b: Someone has usually spent years solving the hard part properly. We go looking for what is missing around it — which is almost always the part a person actually touches.
home.how.p4_t: We keep things close to home
home.how.p4_b: Your own machine is where we start, and anything that needs to live elsewhere has to earn that place. When nothing sits in the middle, there is very little that can be taken away from you later.
home.how.p5_t: We test against the real thing
home.how.p5_b: We are wary of tests that only confirm what we already believed. Ours run the real software under real conditions, doing what you would plausibly do with it, because the bugs worth catching sail past the easy checks first.
home.floor.intro: Most of what a studio says about itself is weather. These four are the ground: they hold for anything we build next, and you can hold us to them.
home.floor.f1_t: It's yours, and it stays yours
home.floor.f1_b: Whatever you put in comes back out — readable, portable, never turned into a profile of you.
home.floor.f2_b: No advertising inside our work, and no money to put someone else's interest ahead of yours.
home.floor.f3_t: You can read what it does before you trust it
home.floor.f3_b: Every behaviour worth arguing about is written down in plain language, next to the thing that does it — not buried in a policy nobody reads.
home.floor.f4_t: It keeps working if we stop
home.floor.f4_b: We have no plans to disappear, though it would be careless to write as though nobody ever does. Anything we retire keeps running on the machines it already sits on, and you hear it from us long before you would notice yourself.
